description: Generate an engineering packet for a domain (the open-source version): an ordered list of tickets, each with the audit evidence that justifies it, where the change goes for that stack, implementation steps, acceptance criteria, and an `agentPrompt` you can execute directly. Use this when the user wants you to actually FIX their site rather than just audit it, work the tickets in order, P1 first, showing the user each change before you make it.
name: aeo_packet
